subject: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

Team — kicking off the customer reference + public case study push for Dedicated/Private.

Targets (8–10 week sprint):
- 3–5 signed reference agreements (reference calls + permissioned quotes)
- 2–3 public case studies published (logo + quotes; metrics where possible, ranges OK)

What I need today to get moving:
1) Confirmation we’re aligned on the target counts + focus (Dedicated + Private first; Hosted as a lighter developer story if we have a slam dunk).
2) Nominations: please send your top 5 accounts that are healthy + likely to say “yes” (or add directly to the candidate shortlist). Include relationship owner + any known constraints (NDA, legal, security).
3) Incentives: quick gut check on what we can offer without creating weird precedent.

Attached is a draft timeline for how we’ll run this week-by-week.

Attachment: Reference_Program_Timeline_v0.3.pdf

Proposed incentives (pick 1, capped):
- Conference sponsorship credit (customer chooses event)
- Extended Optimize trial / higher retention in Console for 60–90 days
- Charitable donation in customer’s name

If you can reply with nominations by Fri EOD, we can start outreach early next week.

Thanks,
Camila
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 9:41 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

Aligned on the targets.

Two notes from Sales side:
- Let’s bias to enterprise logos where Dedicated/Private is part of the story. A strong “security + ops” proof point helps late-stage.
- Please add a guardrail that AEs don’t ask customers cold — we route through CSM + you first so we don’t surprise anyone.

I’ll have AEs nominate accounts today. Off the top of my head, the ones I keep hearing good things about:
- Northwind Commerce (Dedicated) — if we can get a clean metric story, this is a flagship
- Atlas Insurance (Dedicated / procurement heavy) — might agree to calls first, then public later
- Aurora Payments (Dedicated interest) — very SLA-driven; could be a strong “reliability” angle

Re incentives: conference credit + donation seem safest. Anything that looks like “discount for quote” will get weird with procurement.

Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Exec Sponsor

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 10:06 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

+1 to the guardrail.

CS constraints to bake in now:
- Reference load limits: recommend max 2 calls/month per customer + a “cooldown” month if they do a big launch / escalation.
- Do-not-contact list: any account with open sev-1/sev-2 or renewal risk gets flagged automatically.
- Approval flow: CSM must sign off before outreach; Legal needed before logo/quote usage.

Nominations (high confidence from the CS side):
- Polaris DevTools (Hosted at scale) — super positive, fast integration story; likely ok with quote even if not a full case study
- Cascade Customer Support — good for reference calls; less likely for public metrics
- Northwind Commerce — agreed, but only if we’re confident on the last 30 days of reliability so we don’t publish during turbulence

If Tyler can add a “CS health / escalation” column to the tracker, we can keep this clean.

Rachel Kim
Customer Success Leadership

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>; Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 11:22 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

From Solutions Eng / DevEx POV, we should standardize what we’ll be able to “prove” in each story so we don’t end up with fluffy narratives.

Happy to commit SE support for:
- Architecture diagram (Dedicated sizing, routing/fallback policies, caching) for each public case study
- Technical validation of any performance claims (p95 latency, throughput, cost per 1M tokens) + measurement method caveats

Recommendation on incentives: Optimize extension is fine if it’s framed as “expanded trial” vs “compensation.” But we need an approval owner (Finance/Legal) to avoid one-offs.

If we’re doing Northwind + Helios + Atlas, we can cover the technical interviews week 4–6 per your timeline.

Markus Klein
Solutions Engineering Lead

---

From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 1:09 PM PT
Subject: Re: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

I’ll own the intake + tracking.

Plan:
- Candidate shortlist lives in the shared Drive sheet (go-to-market/candidate-account-shortlist-v1). I’ll add columns for CS health + legal/compliance complexity.
- I’ll also set up a simple status taxonomy so we can report weekly: Nominated → Outreach sent → Verbal yes → In drafting → Legal review → Approved → Published.

Question: do we want a single Slack channel (e.g. #customer-references) for updates + scheduling, or keep it in the existing marketing channel? My vote: dedicated channel to reduce noise.

Tyler Benson
Marketing Ops

---

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>; Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 4:38 PM PT
Subject: Re: Reference program kickoff: targets (3–5) + incentives + account nominations

Locking decisions + next steps:

1) Targets: confirmed (3–5 signed refs, 2–3 public case studies).
2) Guardrails: approved.
- No cold asks from Sales.
- CSM sign-off required before any customer outreach.
- Cap: 2 calls/month/customer + cooldown option.

3) Incentives (directional):
- Preferred: conference sponsorship credit OR charitable donation.
- Secondary: Optimize extension framed as expanded trial (subject to Finance/Legal approval).

4) Nominations due: Fri EOD.
- Please add your accounts into the shortlist (Tyler will update columns), or email them to me if you can’t access the sheet.

Tyler — please create #customer-references and pin: tracker link + timeline PDF + Confluence playbook.
Markus — thank you; we’ll loop you in starting week 4 for the technical validation/interviews.
Soojin — once we have the top 8–10 candidates, let’s align on story angles + approved claim language.

Attachment stays the same for reference:
- Reference_Program_Timeline_v0.3.pdf

Camila
